summary: Compare h(t, t) = h(fy, fy) = −N|y_ϱ|² with the coordinates of t, which Z(γ)y determines.

steps.claim: For every embedding Φ_v: h(γfy, γfy) = h(fy, fy) (γ is unitary), mapped to ℂ.
Unfolding: h(e_a, t) = (Z(γ)y)_a = 0 gives that the e*-coordinates of t vanish; h(z, t) = −N t_z = D; and h(t, t) = ∑_i |t_{x_i}|² − N|t_z|² while h(fy, fy) = −N|y_ϱ|².
Hence N∑|Φ_v(t_{x_i})|² = |Φ_v(D)|² − N²|Φ_v(y_ϱ)|² (using t_z = −D/N). If this is ≤ 0 it is 0 (a sum of squares), so the X₀-part of t vanishes and t = f·(t restricted to the frame).
